'''Larry Nance, Jr.''' (born January 1, 1993) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently finished his college career for the [[Wyoming Cowboys men's basketball|Wyoming Cowboys]].<ref name=realgm>{{cite web|title=Larry Nance, Jr. Player Profile|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Larry-Nance-Jr/Summary/30624|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=17 March 2015}}</ref> He has been considered one of the best big men in the [[Mountain West Conference]].<ref name=bio>{{cite web|title=Larry Nance Jr. Bio|url=http://www.gowyo.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/larry_nance_jr_765297.html|website=''GoWyo.com''|accessdate=17 March 2015}}</ref> Nance led the 2014-2015 Wyoming Cowboys to their first NCAA Tournament Appearance since 2002.

== Personal ==
Nance is the son of Larry Nance, Sr., a former professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] and [[Phoenix Suns]]. Nance, Sr. was a three-time [[List of NBA All-Stars|NBA All-Star]] and won the league's first [[Slam Dunk Contest]].<ref name=bio />
